Great initiative! Here’s a possible structure to scaffold your solution:

1. Count the occurrences of each digit in the input string.
2. Determine which digits can be used as pairs to form the left and right halves of the palindrome.
3. Identify if you can use any digit as the middle of the palindrome (for odd counts).
4. Construct the left half of the palindrome in descending order.
5. Choose the largest available digit for the palindrome's center (if applicable).
6. Mirror the left half to form the right half.
7. Combine left half, center (if any), and right half to get the final result.
8. Make sure there are no leading zeroes in the final palindrome unless the result is "0".

Keep these steps in mind as you build your function!
